import Uorc.Uorc.Core.RuntimeMachineCompositionTests
open Uorc.Uorc.Core
open RuntimeMachineCompositionTests
#eval (match zeroLoopCapturesPrepared 5000 with
 | .ok _ => IO.println "zeroLoopCapturesPrepared: pass"
 | .error (.audit n) => throw (IO.userError s!"zeroLoopCapturesPrepared: audit {n}")
 | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "zeroLoopCapturesPrepared: other typed error") : IO Unit)
#eval (do
 match ReferenceSemantics.evaluateGraph zeroLoopGraph [] with
 | .error (.static error) => IO.println s!"reference_static_code={RuntimeMachineTests.staticCode error}"
 | _ => throw (IO.userError "reference witness")
 let initial ← match zeroLoopStart with | .ok s => pure s | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "start")
 let actual ← match RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.settle 5000 initial with | .ok s => pure s | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "settle")
 unless RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.audit actual do throw (IO.userError "heap audit")
 match actual.disposition with
 | .completed output =>
   let length ← match RuntimeSequence.length actual.arena output with | .ok n => pure n | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "length")
   IO.println s!"actual_completed_output_length={length} semantic_work={actual.semanticLedger.semanticWork}"
 | _ => throw (IO.userError "unexpected old disposition")
 match RuntimeMachineSemanticPrefixTests.cleanup 5000 actual actual.semanticLedger with
 | .ok _ => IO.println "actual_cleanup_inventory_zero: pass"
 | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "cleanup") : IO Unit)
